text.text_excerpt: My favorite donuts. Seriously. Looks like a typical donut shop. Parking is kind of difficult sometimes but I'm usually able to grab a spot in the front. Service is quick. Usually regulars sitting in here chatting but always peaceful and happy environment. Glaze donuts here are delicious! I have not ever had an issue of being sold old donuts here unlike some other places I've been to on multiple occasions (whom will be getting separate, less optimistic reviews). I haven't tried anything else because when I go to donut shops, I shop for donuts. I don't sit in and eat. I just order to go and bring them home to gobble in the privacy of my own home with no witnesses to my gluttony. Terrytown C...

I have been coming here for years. This is probably my favorite donuts shop. Plus I get their breakfast platters and hot sausage sandwiches. Parking is horrible here when it is crowded. There's regular who go in and sit at the counter and talk but they were very welcoming.

Come on, how many places can you legitimately say that you walked out with a donut that cost less than a dollar and left you wanting more? This is legitimately my favorite donut shop in NOLA. And I feel that my opinion is vindicated every time I bite into a 75 cent blueberry cake donut. If you take my opinion on anything, this should be the thing that you take it on. Its 24/7, great donuts, a great price, and unbeatable in my opinion. It's in the East (on Downman) so people can feel uneasy going at night, but I'm a white guy and I've never felt uneasy going at any time. If you go late, just ring the doorbell.
